C. 'not chemically related to': The subject drug does not share a chemical structure or mechanism of action with the substance specified by the object entity.
D. 'has no identified risk of': The subject drug has not been associated with the specified risk or adverse outcome in available data.
E. 'has maximum dose': The subject drug should not exceed the maximum dose specified by the object entity.
